description: Search tools, services and funding programmes for African founders. Filter by country, category, funding phase or free tier. Each result says which countries it works in, when to use it, when to skip it, and the local catch.

africa_native.description: True to return only African-built products.

category.description: Category slug, from list_categories. For example 'payments' or 'legal-compliance'.

country.description: ISO code of the market: NG, GH, KE, ZA, EG, RW, TN, MA, SN, CI, ET, TZ, UG, DZ, CM, ZW, ZM, AO, SD. Entries marked Pan-African match any country. Set this whenever the user named a country.

free_tier.description: Limit to entries with a free tier, without one, or trial-only.

phase.description: Stage of the journey. 'Start' is incorporation and banking, 'Money' is payments and funding, 'Build' is product, 'Grow' is sales and marketing.

query.description: Keywords: a need, a category or a name, e.g. 'payment gateway', 'company registration', 'Paystack'. Leave empty to browse by filter alone.

name: search_tools
title: Search African startup tools and funding
